blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines–National University dealt University of the Philippines its first loss in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament, 72-64, at Mall of Asia Arena on Saturday. After a convincing win over the University of the East last week, the Bulldogs dominated again to improve to 2-1. “They really stepped up to the challenge of needing to fight UP. We’re a young team,” coach Jeff Napa said. “Somehow, we made a collective effort to get this win.” NU’s hot start propelled the Bulldogs to a 25-12 lead after the first quarter. […]...
